egress.terms: Direct links need a CNY 0.10 Alipay payment for real-name verification; WebDAV is given away free around holidays, which is a promotion and not a standing entitlement

tooling: WebDAV when granted; otherwise the web interface only
chaining: 61 GB per account with a per-account real-name step that costs CNY 0.10, so it is 90 accounts for 5 TB and 330 for the 20 TiB archive. Nothing about it scales and the protocol is the one that closes

limits.value: 61 GB account total, which is the cap in practice
WebDAV is issued around holidays and is not a standing entitlement

identity_cost.detail: a Chinese-language signup; the forum post describes a domestic vendor and a CNY 0.10 Alipay real-name payment for direct links. No account was created

reliability_note: A small domestic host whose WebDAV availability is seasonal, so any automation built on it breaks on a holiday schedule the operator does not publish

evidence.proved: '61Cloud 这个也挺不错，国内商家，注册送61g。不过国内直链功能需要支付宝付1毛钱用于实名，逢年过节还有免费webdav功能发放'

binding_note: 61 GB is 12% of the 500 GB filter, and the only protocol it offers is a promotion. Either number alone closes it.
notes: One forum post is the whole evidence base, which is why the rung is `reported` and the record has no quota URL of its own. Recorded so nobody re-tests it: 61 GB and a seasonal WebDAV is not a plan.

extras.realname_cost: CNY 0.10 via Alipay, for direct links only
